posts.name: Ronway
posts.cooked: Since it also at the end of your turn you'll draw a card before it activates. So maybe Slip through time was the best you have at the time, so you want to see if you can draw something better to play. It'll allow you to have a chance to draw something and then immediately play that something. All while using two powers this round.

posts.name: broccoli
posts.cooked:
Just one extra use I thought I'd mention....

When there's good damage buffing out and/or you REALLY need something dead NOW, I use Slip Through Time to pull off both Rocket Punches (they're not limited) in a single round.  Without buffing, and ignoring your components, it's still 6 damage in a round, but for each +1 damage, you increase that by 4, so with Inspiring Presnce, Galvanize, and maybe something from the environment, it can get gross pretty quick.
